mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tg_group ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tg_group (group_id, group_name, invite_link, welcome_enabled, welcome_message, ad_enabled, ad_interval_minutes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{inviteLink}, #{welcomeEnabled}, #{welcomeMessage}, #{adEnabled}, #{adIntervalMinutes}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tg_group SET group_id = #{groupId}, group_name = #{groupName}, invite_link = #{inviteLink}, welcome_enabled = #{welcomeEnabled}, welcome_message = #{welcomeMessage}, ad_enabled = #{adEnabled}, ad_interval_minutes = #{adIntervalMinutes}, last_ad_time = #{lastAdTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tg_group WHERE group_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC
